text:
incident-bot: ALERT INC-2026-073 — Elevated 5xx rate detected from dedicated pool 'lh-prod-eu' serving Lighthouse Pharma (VPC tenant). rolling 5m error rate = 18% (> alert threshold). Paging on-call: @sophia :rotating_light:

sophia (oncall): I'm on it. Observability link?

raj (infra): Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd/lh-prod-eu?orgId=1 — canary shard (10%) shows 65% errors, baseline 0-2%. Logs show transient CUDA OOMs + repeated model load errors.

kevin (sre): Confirmed. Canary started at 2141592000 with artifact: lighthouse-model@2026-03-05-quant. Canary traffic = 10% -> unhealthy.

lighthouse-support: Customer monitoring: ~40% of API calls from their end are getting 502/504. They report timeouts in clinical ingestion pipeline. Please advise ETA.

elaine (support): I told them we're investigating and will update within 15m. Can we isolate only their tenant?

raj (infra): This is dedicated pool for the customer — we can divert their traffic to pinned snapshot or previous artifact. Options: 1) pin to previous artifact (lighthouse-model@2026-02-20-stable), 2) reroute to fallback variant (quant->int8 fallback), 3) drain canary nodes and roll back.

sophia (oncall): Priority: maintain customer availability. Short term -> flip their traffic to the pinned stable artifact. Who can run the pin?

kevin (sre): I can do it. Preparing commands. Will perform in canary first then full pool if green.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: user=kevin action=pin-artifact pool=lh-prod-eu target_artifact=lighthouse-model@2026-02-20-stable canary=10%

kevin (sre): Running redwoodctl deploy --pool lh-prod-eu --artifact lighthouse-model@2026-02-20-stable --promote-canary=false

```
# quick check tail of logs for model load failures
redwoodctl logs --pool lh-prod-eu --since 5m | grep -i "model load" | tail -n 20
```

kevin (sre): logs show previous artifact loads succeed; initiating pinned promotion for Lighthouse customer only (traffic-target specific).

raj (infra): Note: there was also a kernel upgrade on the nodes at 2141591800. I'm rolling a config check to ensure kernel-level optimizations are not triggering quant path regressions.

kevin (sre): Ok pinning user-tenant routing now: redwoodctl route set --tenant lighthouse-pharma --pool lh-prod-eu --artifact lighthouse-model@2026-02-20-stable --force

deploy-bot: Action accepted. Job=deploy-2141592685-kevin status=running

sophia (oncall): I'll watch SLOs and error budget windows. If errors persist after pin, escalate to full pool revert.

lighthouse-support: Thanks. We'll hold production traffic steady but can throttle non-critical pipelines.

kevin (sre): Canary traffic (10%) now on pinned artifact. Observing metrics... 2m

raj (infra): Kernel config check completed — no mismatches. The CUDA OOMs appear tied to a new attention kernel in the 2026-03-05 artifact. That matches the pattern.

kevin (sre): Good signal. Canary error rate dropped from 65% -> 1.8% after pin. Rolling traffic for customer to 100% pinned artifact over next 3 minutes: redwoodctl route update --tenant lighthouse-pharma --percent 100 --step 3m

deploy-bot: Route update job=route-2141592790-kevin status=success details="traffic routed -> lighthouse-model@2026-02-20-stable (100%)"

lighthouse-support: Confirmed on our side — 502s cleared within ~90s. Clinical ingest backlog draining. Huge help.

elaine (support): I'll send customer a brief incident note and set expectation for postmortem.

sophia (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline for a scheduled meeting in 15m. Kevin, Raj — you're owners for mitigation and postmortem. I'll still be reachable if needed.

kevin (sre): Taking ownership. Next actions: 1) keep pinned artifact for customer until we validate fix for quant-attention kernel, 2) snapshot logs and heap profiles from failing runs, 3) schedule rollback of kernel upgrade on a canary set if repro.

raj (infra): I'm collecting node-level traces and will open a ticket with the runtime team (rt-2141592900) with attached dmesg + nvml snapshots.

kevin (sre): Creating incident postmortem draft and will include timeline, RCA candidates (attention kernel regression in 2026-03-05 build), impact (customer-facing 40% errors -> mitigated), and remediation plan.

lighthouse-support: Appreciate the quick action. Please include expected ETA for full fix. We'll update our internal stakeholders.

elaine (support): ETA for patch depends on runtime team's investigation; I'll coordinate. For now, advising customer that pinned artifact is stable and we don't expect further interruptions.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE INC-2026-073 — status=mitigated, owner=kevin (sre), mitigation=pinned to lighthouse-model@2026-02-20-stable for tenant lighthouse-pharma

kevin (sre): Closing loop here: mitigation confirmed stable for 25m. Leaving ticket open for RCA and permanent fix.

sophia (oncall): Thanks team. I'll mark my on-call handoff in the rota.

elaine (support): I'll draft the customer follow-up and send within 30m.

kevin (sre): Filing follow-up: ACTION ITEMS: [raj collect traces], [runtime eng root-cause], [release patch or revert kernel change], [support customer comms].

lighthouse-support: Thanks again — we can close after RCA but fine with holding open until patch.

sophia (oncall): Thread locked for now; ping if regressions. :white_check_mark:
